changes: MongoDB connector (pymongo): test_connection (replica-set aware), discover_schema (list databases/collections with counts + sampled fields), _id-keyset export with batching. Batch source + CDC via Debezium change streams (packed _id + document mapping).

Destination write path (additive, patched in place): import_data (insert, duplicate-key-tolerant), upsert_data (idempotent ReplaceOne keyed on _id / relational key_fields — CDC insert+update), delete_data (delete by key via $in — CDC delete). Collections auto-create on first write; no DDL. supports_destination flipped true.

Destination perf: upsert_data/delete_data ensure a (cached, non-unique) index on the write key when it is not _id — without it each keyed op is a full collection scan (~80x slower at 50k docs; measured 434s→1.2s). Index-creation failures are swallowed so they never fail a batch.

Data Explorer document browse (additive, patched in place): find — read-only; allowlisted filter operators ($where/$function/$accumulator/$expr rejected); 0/1 projection; sort of up to 5 keys; keyset (_id) or skip paging; at most 500 docs; maxTimeMS 15000; 5 MB response budget; Relaxed Extended JSON results. export is unchanged.
